aesthetic: Papier Rouge — a Swiss-Bauhaus hybrid where warm paper-white ground anchors rigorous Müller-Brockmann grid structure, punctuated by surgical red for hierarchy and urgency
chromaticArc: Slides 1–44 hold paper-white ground throughout; red surfaces only at the title, 3 chapter-break slides (using warm grey parchment bg, never dark), and the closing call-to-action — black type carries the full structural load across the remaining 39 slides.
gridStrategy: Title-only slides anchor type at col 6 spanning 28 cols in the upper third; body slides shift the title left to col 4 and drop body copy to row 18–30 at span 36; chapter dividers invert the measure with a single oversized numeral at col 38 and a label at col 6, creating rhythmic counterpoint every 8–10 slides.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: No secondary font is used; weight (400 vs 700) and tracking variation within Helvetica Neue alone establish all hierarchy

accentStrategy: Red is used exclusively as a 1px horizontal rule beneath slide section labels and as the title-slide logotype colour — never as fill, background, or decoration — so its three appearances read as a sharp editorial signal against the white field.
